about_the_game:
💟Story Background💟

For centuries, humanity lived in peace alongside the powerful Monster Girls, regulating them through an ability known as Lustan.

However, for reasons unknown, humans gradually lost the power of Lustan. The Monster Girls fell into a state of "The Uproar" (or "The Turmoil"), initiating attacks on humanity, which led to the slow collapse and destruction of civilization.

You are an ordinary young man surviving in the declining human kingdom of Solavien. In a sudden incident, you discover that you have awakened the long-lost power of Lustan, giving you the ability to subdue the Monster Girls who attack you.

To avoid being "drained dry" by the swarming hordes of Monster Girls, you are forced to take the offensive, actively exploring the Four Great Regions.

Your mission is to capture the Monster Girls, establish a "Contract" with them, and seek a way to stop The Uproar.

Concurrently, through this journey, you will gradually uncover why you alone were able to awaken the power of Lustan, and the true reason humanity lost Lustan in the first place.

💟Explore Ever-Changing Terrain💟

In every adventure, the levels are procedurally generated each time you enter, ensuring that every expedition presents you with different routes and combat environments.

You must adapt to change and respond flexibly to survive in this unknown world!

💟Overwhelming Bullet Barrages💟

This continent is inhabited by various monsters. While they may appear innocent or charming, beware when they unleash an overwhelming barrage of projectiles upon you!

Fortunately, you possess an extraordinary ability: you can capture any monster in the game and have them fight for you!

Every monster possesses a unique firing pattern. Utilize their abilities flexibly to gain the upper hand on the battlefield!

💟Evolve and Transform!💟

A total of 12 Puchimon can "Sublimate" (or "Evolve") into their captivating Humanoid Forms! Deepen your bond with them to unlock a rich variety of exclusive events!

The evolved Puchimon are not only more enchanting in appearance, but they will also demonstrate greater power in combat!

💟Characters💟

Mimosa

Flower Fairies are generally a weak species, yet Mimosa possesses powerful magic. Despite this, she often doubts her own abilities, even though she should be proud.

In your presence, she shyly hides her intense emotions and desires. To maintain her personal purity, she has chosen a life of asceticism, striving to repress the deep longings within her heart.

Cameris

Cameris possesses a mercurial personality, loves to control everything, and has a strong desire for dominance; she is a quintessential hedonist.

She openly expresses her desires in every aspect of life and certainly does not consider you her master—quite the contrary, in fact.

Sif

Sif possesses a fierce protective instinct and sees it as her duty to care for all creatures in the waters, projecting the image of a deeply compassionate mother.

She is generally lenient toward all living beings, but holds an intense hatred for humanity, seeking every means to take revenge. Ironically, her obsession consumed her, causing her to become the very source of destruction plaguing the oceans.

Yurinn

Yurinn is a Puchimon who has lived for centuries in an ancient underground city and possesses immense magical power. At the peak of her power, she can influence the surface, causing the climate to become extremely cold and triggering an Ice Age.

Due to her imposing appearance and immense strength, both humans and other Puchimon keep their distance from her. In reality, however, she is merely a naive and somewhat lonely girl who deeply yearns for companionship.

Mona

Mona is a cheerful inn proprietress who frequently provides the protagonist with all sorts of assistance during their journey. Perched on her shoulder is always a grumpy Guripu—known as the Dark Warlord (Hei Wu Wang).

She sells a wide variety of strange and eccentric goods, and she dislikes men who bargain aggressively.

💟Game Features💟

●Over 25 Puchimon are waiting for you to capture, with more than 50 visual forms! Each monster has a unique attack style!

●A total of 12 Puchimon can evolve into a sultry Humanoid Form. Deepen your bond with them to unlock various events!

●Over 100 pieces of equipment are available for you to freely combine, allowing you to create all sorts of different bullet patterns!

●Explore ever-changing mazes—each expedition offers a different experience!

Capture all the Puchimon and deepen your relationship with them!

content_descriptors.notes: The game include furry characters with revealing outfits and some flirting interaction in the story .

short_description: On a continent inhabited by various monsters, you engage in bullet hell battles while simultaneously capturing the monsters. The game features a raising/training system; by developing a bond with these "Puchimon," they can become your battle companions.
